records.title: PEARL: Training Socratic Tutors with Pedagogically Aligned Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: PEARL uses simulated student trajectories, pedagogical reward modeling and multi-objective reinforcement learning to train tutoring models. The reported contribution is tutoring quality/training, not inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Neural Network Verification using Partial Multi-Neuron Relaxation
records.reason: Partial multi-neuron relaxation improves neural-network verification bounds, with runtime overhead trade-offs for verification queries. This is verification methodology and has no LLM inference-system mechanism.

records.title: Configurable Reward Model for Balanced Safety Alignment
records.reason: The paper proposes configurable safety reward modeling for downstream alignment/policy optimization. It does not reduce LLM inference compute, latency, memory, or serving cost.
